title: 第 15 章 赵小胖登场死忠小弟就位第 19 章 系统奖励解锁防御秘术
lines: 午后暖阳铺满陆家院落的青石板，陆坐在院中的石凳上，指尖把玩一枚刚从系统奖励里得来的低阶凝神丹，方才议事堂顺利破局、又救下外门弟子，接连两笔良心收益入账，体内功德源源不断冲刷肉身，原本被天道层层束缚的修行阻碍又淡去一截，炼气巅峰的根基越发扎实。
门外一阵呼呼喘气的脚步声传来，一个胖乎乎的少年满头大汗撞开院门，一身短打布衣被山路尘土沾得灰扑扑，圆脸蛋涨得通红，正是陆家旁系子弟赵小胖。自打灵泉风波闹遍全宗门之后，小胖天天在外到处打探小道消息，但凡有关苏辰的风吹草动，第一时间跑回来禀报，今天更是攥着一卷皱巴巴的记事小本，急匆匆冲到陆衍面前。
“少爷！可算找着您了，我在外边跑了大半个宗门，打探出一大堆要紧消息！”赵小胖一屁股坐在石凳边，也顾不上擦额头汗珠，翻开小本子一条一条细数，“先是苏辰议事吃瘪之后，没在宗门多停留，带着两个贴身跟班一早直奔西郊黑风幽谷，听说幽谷深处长着一株百年凝气灵草，能直接帮修士突破瓶颈，是老天爷送上门的机缘，全靠他天命感应才找到地点，眼下已经守在灵草旁边日夜看护。”
陆衍微微点头，系统此前早就预警黑风幽谷的不义机缘，苏辰靠着天道指引独享灵草，正是自己接下来的截胡目标。
赵小胖接着吐槽，腮帮子气得鼓鼓：“还有更离谱的，苏辰暗地里到处拉拢内门不少天骄，许诺试炼分到的资源对半分，一群贪图好处的弟子扎堆抱大腿，过几日宗门小试炼，他们结成小团伙，到处抢占试炼点位，把零散弟子的机缘全部搜刮走，靠着抱团碾压收割气运。外面全是吹捧苏的，人人都说他重情重义、提携同门，可但凡有人不愿入伙，就被他的跟班处处刁难，前些天就有一名外门弟子拒绝依附，直接被找茬罚去做苦役。”
陆静静听着，时不时随口提问，把试炼的开启时间、试炼地图大致范围、苏辰抱团天骄的人数一一记在心里。

赵小胖说着说着，忽然停下话头，上下仔细打量眼前的陆衍，眼神里满是诧异。从前的原主陆衍是什么性子全宗门人人皆知，一点小事就能火冒三丈，被人嘲讽两句立马拎着家伙找人打架，别人稍微占了陆家一点便宜，当场就要闹到大殿翻脸。可自从灵泉被抢昏迷醒来之后，自家少爷彻底变了模样，被全宗门铺天盖地抹黑唾骂，非但不恼不怒，反倒冷静布局，议事堂有理有据拆穿苏辰的白嫖阴谋，还悄悄出手救助素不相识的底层弟子，行事格局和从前判若两人。
“少爷，您变化也太大了。”赵挠了挠后脑勺，一脸纳闷，“换做以前，听说苏到处拉人算计机缘、处处针对咱们，您早就带着家丁找上门算账了，现在反倒稳坐院子里慢慢规划，我一开始还以为您受打击颓废了，这阵子跟着跑消息才看明白，您是真的长大了。”
陆衍淡淡一笑，没有透露穿越和系统的秘密，只推脱前些天接连经历变故，看透冲动解决不了问题，脑子慢慢想开了。
赵小胖压根没深究真相，在他心里，只要自家少爷变好就是天大的好事，立马拍着胸脯表态：“往后全宗门的情报打探全交给我，哪里有苏辰的小动作、哪里有弟子被欺压，我第一时间摸清楚汇报，跑腿、探路、打探消息我全包，上刀山下火海绝不退缩！”
从前原主虽然蛮横，唯独对小胖这个从小一起长大的发小还算厚道，哪怕全天下都远离陆衍，小胖自始至终没有半点背弃的念头，如今看清少爷心性大变、行事靠谱，更是铁了心一辈子追随。
陆衍收下这份忠心，顺手从储物袋取出几枚低级淬体丹递给小胖：“连日在外奔波劳累，这些丹药拿去稳固修为，往后跟着我，不会让你白白吃苦。”
赵小胖喜滋滋接过丹药，眼睛都亮了，他资质普通，平日里缺修炼资源，一枚淬体丹都来之不易，连忙小心翼翼收好，越发死心塌地。
闲聊间隙，老管家周伯从库房赶来，手里拿着几张宗门下发的试炼文书，躬身禀报：“少爷，宗门正式送来试炼通知，三日之后开启小型野外试炼，试炼山林遍布天材地宝，按收获资源排名发放宗门奖励，苏辰已经提前托人预定了试炼最核心的三处灵脉点位，摆明了要垄断大半机缘。”
陆衍接过文书细细翻看，试炼地图、规则一目了然，试炼禁止私下伤人，但没有规定机缘归属，依旧是强者得之，苏靠着天道加持提前锁定优质点位，又是一笔标准不义机缘，完美落在系统的制衡范围里。
“苏辰仗着天命优势提前占位，咱们不用硬碰硬抢他选定的地盘，专挑他忽略的隐秘点位下手。”陆衍结合小胖打探来的情报，很快定下试炼布局，“他抱团垄断明面资源，我就专找藏在山洞、崖缝里的隐藏宝物，既避开正面团战，又能悄悄截胡机缘，全程不与人动手，照样完成制衡。”
赵小胖连连点头，一边在小本子上记录规划，一边补充各类小道消息：“我打听到，苏为了稳妥拿下灵草，在黑风幽谷外围布下简易困阵，闲杂人等靠近就会触发警报，寻常修士根本没法悄摸靠近灵草生长的山谷，想要硬闯多半会被埋伏的跟班围堵。”
陆早有预判，苏吃过灵泉机缘莫名消失的亏，吸取教训严加防备，可对方只懂在外围布防，忽略幽谷地底的暗渠通道，那是自己敲定的潜入突破口。
就在三人继续商议细节之时，院外忽然传来不少弟子的议论声，全在吹捧苏辰即将坐拥灵草、试炼独占鳌头，顺带踩一脚陆衍依旧是没用的纨绔，听到这些闲话，赵小胖当场就要冲出去和路人争辩，被陆伸手拦了下来。
“现在争辩无用，等到试炼和幽谷两件事落地，所有谣言不攻自破。”陆衍语气淡然，靠着连日积攒的功德，自身天道抗性持续上涨，外界的闲言碎语已经很难再带来心绪波动。
小胖悻悻坐下，继续梳理搜集来的情报，把苏辰手下每一名跟班的修为、性格弱点挨个标注，方便后续针对性布局。
不知不觉天色渐晚，天边染上一层昏黄，陆衍正打算吃过晚饭之后，择定夜里动身前往黑风幽谷探查地形，系统突然弹出新的任务提醒。【主线临时任务触发：试炼阶段截断苏辰垄断的试炼机缘，破坏其靠抱团收割气运的计划，任务成功奖励海量修为与专属防御功法；任务失败，宿主短期天道压制小幅回升。】

In the afternoon, the warm sun covered the bluestone in the courtyard of the Lu family. Lu was sitting on the stone bench in the courtyard, playing with a low-level concentration pill that he had just received from the system reward. Just now, the Council successfully broke through the situation and rescued the outer disciples. Two consecutive gains of conscience were recorded in his account. The merits in his body continued to wash away the physical body. The barriers to cultivation that were originally bound by the heavenly ways faded away, and the foundation for the peak of Qi refining became more solid.
There was a sound of breathing footsteps outside the door, and a chubby young man, sweating profusely, opened the courtyard door. His shorts were stained with dust from the mountain road, and his round face was flushed. He was Zhao Xiaopang, a descendant of the Lu family. Ever since the Lingquan turmoil spread throughout the sect, Little Fatty has been out searching for gossip every day. Whenever there is any gossip about Su Chen, he immediately comes back to report it. Today, he hurriedly rushed to Lu Yan with a crumpled notebook in his hand.
"Master! I've finally found you. I traveled most of the sect and found out a lot of important information!" Zhao Xiaopang sat down on the edge of the stone bench. He didn't even bother to wipe the sweat from his forehead. He opened a small book and counted each item one by one. "First, Su Chen failed to discuss matters and didn't stay in the sect much longer. , took two personal followers and went straight to the Black Wind Valley in the western suburbs early in the morning. I heard that there is a hundred-year-old Qi Condensing Spirit Grass growing deep in the valley, which can directly help the monks break through the bottleneck. It was an opportunity sent to me by God. It was only through his destiny that I found the location. Now I have been guarding the spirit grass day and night. "
Lu Yan nodded slightly. The system had already warned of the unjust opportunity in Black Wind Valley. Su Chen relied on the guidance of heaven to monopolize the spiritual grass, which was his next target.
Fatty Zhao continued to complain, his cheeks bulging with anger: "What's even more outrageous is that Su Chen secretly wooed many geniuses from the inner sect and promised to divide the resources allocated to the trial in half. A group of disciples who were greedy for benefits gathered together and hugged each other. After a few days of the sect's small trial, they formed a small gang and seized the trial points everywhere. Opportunities for loose disciples are taken away, and luck is harvested by clinging to a group. Everyone praises Su. Everyone says that he values friendship and righteousness, and supports his fellow disciples. However, if anyone is unwilling to join the group, his followers will make things difficult for him. A few days ago, an outer disciple refused to join and was directly punished to do hard labor. "
Lu Jingjing listened, asking questions casually from time to time, keeping in mind the start time of the trial, the approximate scope of the trial map, and the number of people in Su Chen's group of geniuses.
As Zhao Xiaopang was talking, he suddenly stopped talking and carefully looked up and down at Lu Yan in front of him, his eyes full of surprise. The temperament of the former original owner Lu Yan was well known to everyone in the sect. He would get angry at the slightest thing. If someone laughed at him, he would immediately start a fight with someone. If someone took advantage of the Lu family, he would fall out in the main hall on the spot. But since the Lingquan was robbed and he woke up from a coma, his young master has completely changed his appearance. He has been slandered and slandered by the entire sect. Instead of being angry or angry, he has calmly laid out the plan. The council has reasonable and evidence-based explanations to expose Su Chen's free prostitution conspiracy. He also secretly rescues the low-level disciples whom he has never met before. His behavior is completely different from before.
"Master, you have changed so much." Zhao scratched the back of his head with a puzzled look on his face, "In the past, I heard that Su was recruiting people to plot opportunities and target us, and you had already brought your family to come to settle accounts. Now instead, you sit quietly in the yard and slowly plan. I thought you were depressed at first, but after following the news recently, I realized that you have really grown up."
Lu Yan smiled faintly and did not reveal the secrets of time travel and the system. He only excused himself from the changes he had experienced in the past few days. He saw that impulsiveness could not solve the problem and slowly thought about it.
Fatty Zhao didn't delve into the truth at all. In his heart, as long as his young master gets better, it would be a great good thing. He immediately patted his chest and declared: "From now on, all the intelligence gathering of the entire sect will be left to me. Wherever there are Su Chen's little tricks or where the disciples are being bullied, I will find out and report immediately. I will do all the errands, explore the road, and find out the information. I will never back down even if I go up to the mountain of swords or the sea of fire!"
Although the original owner was overbearing in the past, he was kind to Xiaopang, the boy he had grown up with. Even if the whole world stayed away from Lu Yan, Xiaopang never had the slightest idea of abandoning him. Now that he has seen the young master's change of heart and his reliable behavior, he is determined to follow him for the rest of his life.
Lu Yan accepted this loyalty and took out a few low-level body tempering pills from the storage bag and handed them to Xiaopang: "I am tired from running around for days. Take these pills to stabilize your cultivation. Follow me and I won't let you suffer in vain."
Fatty Zhao happily took the elixir and his eyes lit up. He had ordinary qualifications and lacked training resources. Even a body tempering elixir was hard to come by. He quickly put it away carefully and became more and more desperate.
During the chat, the old butler Zhou Bo came from the warehouse, holding several trial documents issued by the sect in his hand, and bowed to report: "Master, the sect has officially sent the trial notice. In three days, the small outdoor trial will start. The trial mountain forest is full of natural materials and treasures, and the sect rewards will be distributed according to the ranking of harvested resources. Su Chen has already entrusted someone to reserve the three core spiritual points of the trial in advance, making it clear that he will monopolize most of the opportunities."
Lu Yan took the document and looked through it carefully. The trial map and rules were clear at a glance. In the trial, it was forbidden to hurt people in private, but there was no stipulation on the ownership of the opportunity. It was still obtained by the strong. Su relied on the blessing of heaven to lock the high-quality points in advance. It was another standard unjust opportunity, which perfectly fell within the checks and balances of the system.
"Su Chen took advantage of his destiny to occupy the position in advance. We don't have to fight head-on to seize the territory he selected, but focus on the secret points he ignored." Lu Yan quickly decided on the trial layout based on the information obtained by Xiaopang. "He formed a group to monopolize the surface resources, and I focused on finding hidden treasures hidden in caves and crevices in the cliffs. This not only avoids direct battles, but also quietly intercepts opportunities, without touching anyone during the whole process, and still completes the checks and balances."
Fatty Zhao nodded repeatedly, while recording the plan in a small notebook, while adding various gossips: "I heard that in order to securely capture the spiritual grass, Su set up a simple trap around the Black Wind Valley. Anyone who comes near will trigger an alarm. Ordinary monks cannot sneak close to the valley where the spiritual grass grows. If they try to force their way in, they will most likely be surrounded by ambushed followers."
Lu had already predicted that Su had suffered the loss of Lingquan's inexplicable disappearance, and had learned his lesson to take strict precautions. However, the other party only knew how to set up defenses on the outside and ignored the culverts underneath the valley, which he had decided to break through.
While the three of them were continuing to discuss the details, a lot of disciples' chatter suddenly came from outside the courtyard, all of which were boasting that Su Chen was about to get the spiritual grass and be the best in the trial. They also stepped on Lu Yan for still being a useless playboy. After hearing these gossips, Zhao Xiaopang was about to rush out to argue with passers-by, but Lu stretched out his hand to stop him.
"It's useless to argue now. When the trial and the valley are settled, all the rumors will be self-defeating." Lu Yan said calmly. With the merit accumulated in the past few days, his own resistance to heaven continued to rise, and the gossip from the outside world could no longer bring about mood swings.
The little fat man sat down angrily and continued to sort out the collected information, marking the cultivation level and character weaknesses of each of Su Chen's followers one by one to facilitate subsequent targeted planning.
Unknowingly, it was getting late, and the sky was covered with a layer of yellow. Lu Yan was planning to set off to the Black Wind Valley at night to explore the terrain after dinner, when a new mission reminder suddenly popped up in the system. [The main line temporary mission triggers: The trial phase cuts off Su Chen’s monopoly on trial opportunities and destroys his plan to harvest luck by teaming up. Successful missions will reward massive cultivation and exclusive defensive skills; mission failure will result in a slight increase in the host’s short-term Heavenly Suppression. 】
